title: Cosmon
description: Cosmon develops agentic artificial intelligence software for mechanical engineering workflows, centered on its Nexus product for CAD, CAE, simulation, and PLM tasks. Its website presents the company as a software provider whose platform automates drawing creation, simulation setup, troubleshooting, design validation, and product lifecycle data tasks while integrating directly with major engineering tools. Although the offering is deeply technical and tailored to engineering environments, the core business shown is the development and delivery of proprietary engineering software rather than providing outsourced engineering services or general consulting. https://cosmon.com https://www.zoominfo.com/c/cosmon/5000578320
